entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Validation not firing when pressing submit button on nested numeric property #62039
  • Blazor SSR - RemoteNavigationManager should be made public #62035
  • Wasm for updated nuget reference not updated on build #62031
  • Support PQC certificates for HTTPS #62030
  • Perf regression: multiple_queries #62026
  • Perf improvement: fortunes_dapper, json #62025
  • OpenAPI Schema generation stackoverflow when converting Flags enum to a string array & is used in API models with default value #62023
  • .Net OpenApi - JsonStringEnumConverter Enums should explicitly be generated as string type (to be rendered correctly by SwaggerUI) #62022
  • Perf improvement: multiple_queries, mvc #62014
  • [Known Build Error] Ssl connection could not be established #62008

Closed

  • Pin markdownlint-cli version in markdownlint.yml #62033
  • CORS preflight request gets 405 back on Minimal API #62029
  • Add examples to xmldoc for AddOpenAPI extension methods/overloads #58807
  • Perf regression: httpsys-encoded-url #62001
  • Non-required build failures due to new Markdown rules #62003
  • Drive case insensitivity on Windows causes "Error BLAZOR105: More than one JS module files were found for the razor component" (but there isn't) #62021
  • Run two or more independent Blazor WASM Applications in scope of one page. #61970
  • Duplicate TargetFrameworkAttribute errors in .NET 9.0 Blazor projects with VS Code #61998
